title: PlaybookRule
description: A single deterministic rule evaluated by the rules engine. Conditions use JSONLogic; actions specify flags, score modifiers, and checklist items.

rule_code.description: Unique identifier within the playbook, e.g. 'RULE-001'

name.description: Human-readable rule name, e.g. 'Policy Exclusion Gate'

source_section.description: Source playbook section reference, e.g. 'Section 9, Rule 1'

priority.description: Evaluation order. Lower numbers run first. Halt rules must have lowest priority values.

halt_on_trigger.description: If true, the entire assessment halts when this rule triggers. Used for exclusion gates.

condition.description: JSONLogic condition evaluated against ClaimState. Returns boolean. Use {"var": "path"} to reference claim fields.

actions.description: Actions to apply when the rule triggers

flags.description: Flag codes to raise. Must exist in the playbook's flags table.

checklist_items.description: Checklist instructions added to missing-evidence output

text.description: Instruction text. May include {postcode} and {date_of_loss} template vars.

score_modifiers.description: Adjustments applied to specific scoring dimensions after base scoring

dimension_key.description: Must match a key in the playbook's scoring_dimensions

delta.description: Score adjustment. Positive = boost, negative = penalty. Clamped to [0, max_score].

classification.description: Optional classification label applied to the claim when the rule triggers

notes.description: Free-text notes added to the assessment when the rule triggers. Drawn from case precedents.

checklist_items.text: Obtain full policy wording to confirm fence exclusion applies

notes: Damage type is within a commonly excluded category. Assessment halted pending policy wording review.
